title: Underground Mall and Casino Under Main Street
content: I dreamed that I was at the MallWorld Casino and Shopping Mall last night. It started at the Casino, mostly empty, except for employees wearing fake western-style uniforms. I remember they had vests and string ties, like dealers had in Las Vegas back in the 50s. The bar was closed on Monday nights, so that was disappointing! My husband and I went upstairs and outside. We were on the kind of Main Street you saw in the 50's, except that when you entered a dry-goods store you could take an escalator downstairs to an enormous mall with many modern stores. They had a great display of attractive merchandise. There were few customers, and the chubby, gray-haired Mayor was bustling around, complaining about the lack of foot traffic. I told him that the vintage facade to the mall kept customers from coming in. It wasn't a very interesting dream, except that when I woke up I realized that my MallWorld and Casino Resort are mostly subterranean. Other posters have windows in theirs! Does anybody else have dream lives that are mostly underground?
